answer: A vault holding rewards for onyx and shale classification should pay for independently sampled correct labels, never for opening accounts. Hide reference labels, assign fresh samples after commitment, and require a nonrefundable per-task fee smaller than honest expected payment but larger than random guessing earns. Aliases then multiply fees along with attempts; attackers need real classification ability to profit. Leaked references or correlated samples undermine the test, so rotate the hidden set and audit its independence.
